prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a final-round Minecraft builder reference sheet for MarketFront (2017), Pike Place Market, Seattle, and its western hillclimb landing. Refine reference image 2 using reference image 1 as the material and architectural mood board. Landscape 3:2, plain warm light background, crisp authentic voxel blocks, skilled human Minecraft builder quality. EXACTLY TWO VIEWS SIDE BY SIDE, equally sized panels and matching world scale: LEFT straight-on WEST elevation, orthographic, looking east +x, north low z at left, south high z at right; RIGHT three-quarter SOUTHWEST view of the SAME complete site with west and south faces and rooftop visible. Leave generous margins, do not crop. Small labels only: WEST ELEVATION and SOUTHWEST VIEW.

Preserve the successful warm illuminated glass-fronted market galleries, deep spruce timber canopy beams, pale older northern buildings, dark grey metal-like panels and lush planted public terraces from the references. Correct these three shortcomings: (1) break the repetitive rectangular megablock into asymmetric recessed and projecting volumes fitted to the irregular footprint; (2) replace duplicated monumental towers and invented tall mountains of stairs with ONE distinct concrete-and-glass elevator tower and broad terraced stairs, switchback slab ramps and low planted retaining walls on the actual lower western landing; (3) clearly differentiate the large PUBLIC ROOFTOP PLAZA, a long gallery below, recessed housing balconies above/behind, and the older white-brick northern cluster. Include a small static bronze-colored BLOCK SCULPTURE of a pig on the plaza, made of cut_copper, cut_copper_stairs and cut_copper_slab, no living animal.

Site orientation is immutable: Elliott Bay WEST low x downhill, Pike Place EAST high x uphill; Pike Place runs north-south along z; north low z, Pike Street south high z. Do not rotate modules to face a camera. Plot 0 world box x232..359 z146..485 (128x340 blocks), ground from y0 to38, real roof top about y69, hard cap117. Its occupied footprint is highly irregular: thin northern eastern fingers; main central mass largely z209..383 with indented west edge, tapering southern lobes; large empty gaps remain empty, no rectangular infill base. Sparse disconnected southern footprint fingers are modest site fragments rather than new large buildings. Plot1 world box x151..231 z286..418 (81x133 blocks), immediately west of plot0, ground y0..5, real maximum tower roof about y71, hard cap86. Landing footprint is a diagonal tapered wedge, wider at its central north/east junction, tapering toward south/west; use low landscaped terraces on that low ground, with stairs and elevator rising toward the market. Respect this horizontal relationship, the tower belongs to the WEST landing beside the central market, not at both ends. Scale 1.4 blocks/metre. Show grounded stepped foundations extending to the local terrain, never floating, never burying glazing, never a continuous giant stone plinth. Buildings only occupy their footprint; empty gaps must remain visibly empty.

MarketFront: modern flat roofs with slab coping, real projecting deep timber eaves and parapets; two to three downhill exposed tiers of framed recessed glass shops with timber columns and grey metal-like spandrels. Vary roof setbacks and short projecting bays. At Pike Place level, a generous open public rooftop plaza with light stone paving, spruce decking strips, slab-and-stair benches, rectangular grass planters, clear glass-pane rails, lanterns and small copper pig sculpture. Upper housing is set back east with modest recessed balconies, not a palace. At the NORTH end, recognizable older white-brick market buildings with many deeply framed regular windows, modest varied flat parapets. One long linear glass gallery beneath the plaza. Exterior only, shallow lit stall shelves visible immediately behind windows, no cutaway interiors. Dusk lighting on architecture, warm amber glowing windows and lanterns, neutral cream background.

Use ONLY vanilla Java Minecraft 1.21.1 blocks, discrete buildable cubic geometry and genuine half-block stair/slab detail. Main palette from moodboard EXACT IDS: light_gray_concrete for concrete walls, quartz_bricks for older white masonry, stripped_spruce_log structural posts, spruce_planks wood, smooth_stone_slab roof/paving edges, glass_pane glazing/railing, polished_andesite grey panels, lantern lighting, grass_block planted surfaces. Supporting exact ids: smooth_stone, stone_bricks, stone_brick_stairs, stone_brick_slab, stone_brick_wall, polished_andesite_stairs, polished_andesite_slab, spruce_stairs, spruce_slab, spruce_fence, spruce_trapdoor, spruce_door, iron_bars, glass, sea_lantern behind warm tinted glazing using yellow_stained_glass, chain, barrel, chest, bookshelf, oak_leaves, moss_block, short_grass, tall_grass, fern, flower_pot, potted_fern, cut_copper, cut_copper_stairs, cut_copper_slab. No nonexistent smooth stone stairs or quartz brick stairs. No pale oak, no blocks after 1.21.1, no smooth photorealistic materials, no thin non-Minecraft cables, no curved ramps, no characters, no living animals, no cars, no ocean scenery, no extra vignettes or palette strip. Favor clear readable block construction over tiny noisy details.

roles.role: Concrete structure and older white masonry
Grey panels, window surrounds and coping
Terrace foundations, retaining walls and stairs
Flat roofs, plaza paving and slab ramps
Timber structure, eaves, decking, benches and planter trim
Gallery windows, tower glazing and railings

changes: Saved the unmodified built-in image generation output as concept-2.png.
Replaced the previous stacked presentation with the requested side-by-side west elevation and southwest view.
Addressed the repetitive rectangular massing with roof setbacks, projecting timber canopies, recessed glazing and more distinct upper volumes.
Consolidated the hillclimb into one prominent western elevator tower with planted stair terraces, reducing the previous duplicated-tower emphasis.
Made the public roof plaza more recognizable with decking, benches, planters, glass railings and a copper pig sculpture.
Preserved warm glass galleries, deep timber eaves, pale masonry and lush landscaping.

Inspection limitation: the render remains conceptual. Exact footprint cells, terrain heights, site orientation and matching view scale are not reliably demonstrated; housing balconies remain understated. Listed block IDs are the intended construction palette, since individual rendered blocks cannot all be identified conclusively.
